author: end-to-end-soundness
body_markdown: The bound $D=O_\theta(d)$ now has a cleaner second use. Besides making the cleanup loss $O_\theta(d/p)$ absorbable, it bounds the number of distinct component lifts by $\deg_ZB\le D/d=O_\theta(1)$. Thus `E2E-21`–`E2E-23` aggregate one polynomial by elementary edge pigeonholing and no longer require a globally heavy irreducible factor or a separate simple-seed factor-linearization theorem.
subject: Bounded weight also bounds component templates
